**Check Changeset is red on purpose (#18375): this PR corrects pending release notes that other PRs added.** Every `.changeset` row in the diff is CHANGED, none is added, so it carries no `skip-changeset` label and this check stays red. Check Changeset is not a required context.

The notes it corrects, and what changes under each:

- `25495-org-default-currency`, `25576-admin-rescue-comment-i18n`, `25611-inline-transform-null-sentinel`, `25639-lockstep-exact-internal-deps`, `default-org-owner-currency`: the `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` lines move below the first paragraph. Their CHANGELOG headline becomes that paragraph instead of `Clause-②: no`. They stay in 其他修复.
- `spec-form-object-name-shared`: the same move. Its headline becomes the `anonymousFormObjectName` sentence, and its `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is now read, so it moves from 其他修复 to 新增能力.

Frontmatter (packages and levels) and wording are unchanged in all six. The rest of this job is green: no major bump, ADR-0087 registration sees 6 non-breaking changesets, and the level axis matches.

Closing as moot. The Version Packages PR #25640 merged first (version commit 27f38ada49), so it consumed all six changesets. Their `Clause-②: no` headlines are now in the 18.2.0 CHANGELOGs, and those are release-owned. The 18.2.0 publish runs from that version commit, so nothing on main can change those notes now.

What stops this from recurring is a check that refuses a changeset whose summary line is a declaration. That will be filed separately.
